snippet.title: Home Alone With Michael Jackson: Macaulay Culkin's UNTOLD Story (Full Documentary) | the detail.
snippet.description:
We explore one of the most misunderstood friendships in pop culture.  From 'Home Alone' superstardom to life inside Neverland Ranch, this film uncovers the truth behind Michael Jackson and Macaulay Culkin’s unique bond — a friendship shaped by fame, loneliness, and a shared search for normality.  

Through rare interviews, news footage, and archival clips, we revisit the moments that defined their relationship, from the making of MJ's 'Black or White' to the courtroom years and beyond. Was their friendship genuine, or something the media never truly understood? This is the full story — told in detail.

snippet.title: How Martin Bashir manipulated Michael Jackson (Take Two - Living with Michael Jackson)
snippet.description:
In the wake of currently renewed exposure of Martin Bashir's shady interviewing tactics with Princess Diana, here is a fresh re-upload of the rebuttal show that followed Martin Bashir's even more shady interview docu "Living with Michael Jackson", which led to a circus trial and destroyed Michael's life. "Take Two: The footage you were never meant to see" premiered on FOX, 23rd February 2003.
